meaning: Fits and scores made at `commit` are result-identical to those made at `tag` for every arm except `not_for_arms`; rule scripts and run_stage.py read `commit` as the tag's commit for those arms when rows mix commits, and refuse rows of `not_for_arms` at `commit`. No rescoring. Limits: score rows carry the scorer's commit, not the fit's, so only the stage runner, which also reads each latent's fit commit, can see a Sinkhorn latent fitted at `commit` and rescored at `tag`; the rule scripts see scores only, so a divergence record's commit is checked by the stage runner only, which (SI-85) also refuses a record that carries no commit or was made from a checkout with uncommitted changes; and `not_for_arms` rows are refused only at `commit`, so a stage made entirely at one other commit is not refused by this list.

evidence.shows: 63 fit rows, one per code path, refitted for 1 epoch on CPU with 1 thread at both commits: 59 of 59 non-Sinkhorn rows give identical latents; the 4 Sinkhorn rows differ, as intended (SI-51)
7 stored latents rescored by both versions of the scorer: identical in all 32 compared columns
